name: GoToPreviousSection
description: a link that takes users to the previous section of the current page
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: Native anchor accessibility — the `href` provides the destination, the link text provides the accessible name
keyboard: Tab: moves focus onto the link
Enter: navigates to the linked anchor (native browser behavior)
props: `href`: string (required) — anchor URL of the previous section, typically `#section-id`
`className`: string (optional) — extra CSS classes appended to `go-to-previous-section`
